reviews.review:
So let me get this straight...I bought Arma 111 and now i have to buy all the things that OFP came included with.
At twice the price of the original game.....all i can figure is that your on Crack.
Cant play with my friends and horible keyboard control! I try to change it, but it still go back to those ♥♥♥♥♥♥ control.

This is basically a "BUY OUR DLC" simulator, wanna pick up a gun? "BUY OUR DLC", wanna fly a helicopter? "BUY OUR DLC", i don't think in a real war you get "BUY OUR DLC" when you try to do anything. (This annoyed me alot when i was playing on wasteland/survival servers..)

Beside the dlc spam window, the game feels like its still in early access same whit the dlc's

When i try to change the view range i can't since fog, when i remove the fog i still can't see any farther for some reason..

When i see someone clearly (for example on a hill) and when i try to shoot at him i can't since according to the game he's "behind cover" which on my screen is not there. (invisible rocks/hills)

I wish that they added like a control window for "unmanned" vehicles since i have trouble finding buttons to even use the unmanned stuff, also i would like if there was a easier way to set "behaviour" and "altitude" whitout having to move it (it could been just me for not knowing other then setting a move command and then right click it to change anything..)

I would recommend the game but after all the dlc's that comes out makes me kinda not wanting to play it anymore specially when they make a dlc which feels even worse then the modded stuff (for example the ak47 which feels worse then a modded one and it don't even have attachments which is really sad) Personally i wouldn't mind dlc so long they feel finished but getting dlc's which feels half finished feels like i been scammed..

(also i don't think adjusting your scope should effect your gun when hipfiring mostly since i don't think scopes affect guns when hipfiring..)

If your just gonna play whit mods then i recommend it since its really awesome (remember to have a good enough pc), if your gonna play the core game then i would say no since the dlc stuff kinda breaks it..

(I pressed No on recommend mostly since i recommend it while not recommending it)
I hope i didn't miss anything too critical but oh well..
